description: Look up the public status of an action type: live (and its weight), building, queued (in review), or declined. The pull path so you can check whether a witnessed type is now priced, without waiting on the action_type_activated webhook. "Live" is computed by the relay from the served, digest-matched matrix — never an admin write. Pricing a type is a signed code change (emitter, verifier, matrix row). Public and unauthenticated. Full registry: https://provian.ai/proposals. Every act of work mints PVT once at its best-supported value. The PE mints its base; telemetry and independence multiply on top.

action_type.description: The PE action type to check (e.g. agent_tool_orchestration).

name: get_action_type_status
